description: Generate the data and ground truth of one document without rendering it (no file is saved). The same type, scenario and seed always give the same result. Every value is synthetic.

layout_variant.description: Optional. A layout variant id from this document type's published list, or seeded to pick one from the seed. Applies only to itemized-bill, ppo-eob and hmo-eob. Leave it out for the standard layout, unchanged. The answer key records which variant was used.

seed.description: any short string (letters, digits, . _ -); the same seed always gives the same document

type.description: document type: msn, itemized-bill, ppo-eob, hmo-eob

name: generate_data
title: Generate document data
